Name: Offline & Relevancy Validation
Entry_Criteria: Unit tests pass 100%; token priority heuristic validated on 898 historical zero-result queries.
Exit_Criteria: Manual relevance audit on 200 sampled queries achieves >= 90% acceptable match rating; latency benchmark < 30 ms.

Name: Internal Dogfooding & Shadow Deployment
Entry_Criteria: Phase 0 sign-off; shadow execution deployed behind search gateway.
Exit_Criteria: Shadow traffic validates p95 latency impact < 35 ms under peak load (500 QPS); zero service exceptions.
Monitored_Guardrails: p95 Latency, Error Rate, CPU Utilization
Rollback_Condition: p95 latency > 250 ms or error rate > 0.05%.

Name: Canary A/B Experiment Launch
Entry_Criteria: Phase 1 latency and stability certified; analytics pipeline verified.
Exit_Criteria: Zero client crashes, telemetry parity confirmed, no anomaly alerts.
Monitored_Guardrails: Client Crash Rate, Telemetry Integrity, Search Latency
Rollback_Condition: Telemetry loss or client crash increase.

Name: Full A/B Experimentation
Entry_Criteria: Phase 2 telemetry stability confirmed; experiment assignment active.
Exit_Criteria: Target sample size reached (~5,000 eligible searches); statistical significance evaluated on Primary CTR and Guardrails.
Monitored_Guardrails: Search-to-PDP CTR, ZRR, Quick-back rate, Bounce rate, p95 Latency, Head query CTR
Rollback_Condition: Statistically significant regression in short-query CTR, quick-back rate increase > 1.0 pp, or latency > 250 ms.

Name: Ramped General Availability
Entry_Criteria: Experiment concludes with Statistically Significant positive lift on Primary CTR (p < 0.05) and all guardrails green.
Exit_Criteria: 100% rollout achieved; feature flag converted to permanent search architecture.
Monitored_Guardrails: Overall Marketplace Conversion, Search-to-Order Conversion, Customer Support Tickets
